Wrought iron painting in Montréal

We paint and durably protect your wrought-iron structures. Every project starts with careful preparation: surface protection, cleaning, scraping, sanding and a tough industrial paint.

Types of wrought-iron structures

  • 01Wrought-iron balconies
  • 02Service stairs
  • 03Spiral staircases
  • 04Front-façade stairs
  • 05Railings and fences

A durable, attractive finish protected against corrosion.

Our process

  1. Protecting surrounding surfaces
  2. Scraping and brushing flaking paint
  3. Grinding rust and cleaning
  4. Applying anti-rust primer
  5. Applying industrial metal paint

Durable, resistant paint

We use specialist products for steel and wrought-iron structures, built to withstand the weather and protect for the long term. Depending on the condition of the surfaces and the budget, different options are offered.

If your structure is damaged, we also offer wrought iron restoration and welding in Montréal.
